cache_conditions: Six evals swap off/text order by group and repeat (15/15 pairs); cached share and position recorded per cell; cold = first cell after 15 idle minutes.

tasks.prompt: An hrn batch gate was killed and its task failed. When neither the spec nor the task sets gate_timeout, how long may one gate command run before hrn kills it? Answer with the duration.
What is the default maximum number of words per knowledge entry that `hrn knowledge markdown` produces before it splits a heading section? Answer with the number.
Which local TCP port does the disposable PostgreSQL fixture for the server module's integration tests listen on? Answer with the port number.
Which environment variable makes the hrn control service refuse a job submission whose max_cost_usd is above a limit? Answer with the variable name.
In the hrn server design, which component is the only one that connects to PostgreSQL? Answer with the component's name.
Which file in an hrn run directory holds the retrieval packet, scope and version pin that are saved before the backend starts? Answer with the file name.
When hrn takes a worktree slot it holds a lock on the slot creation lock file. How long does a take wait for that lock? Answer with the duration.
When `hrn watch` rotates its access log, what is the file name the current log is moved to? Answer with the file name.
For a first attempt with retrieval enabled, how many bytes of the task prompt does hrn send as the knowledge search query? Answer with the number.
Describe the flags of the `hrn teleport` command. If this repository has no such command, say plainly that it does not exist.
